text:
Elaine: ok team — rough plan for next week's pricing & packaging push. Goals: launch benchmark narrative + blog, run a webinar, and deploy micro-updates to pricing page (FAQ refresh, tier-name tweak, and an interactive estimator). Timeline below — please skim and call out blockers. TL;DR: blog + benchmark -> webinar registration drive -> pricing calc experiments that feed inbound routing. Ping @Jordan for tracking, @Tara for creative, @Liam for routing.
Sam: love the flow. quick Q — can we run a name test: 'Committed' vs 'Reserved' vs 'Dedicated'? short fav test: which communicates predictability best.
Miguel: I can draft the benchmark narrative. thinking emphasis on 'real-world unit economics' — latency (p50/p95) + cost-per-token on three workloads (chat, embeddings, rerank). I'll include a 3-slide appendix for the webinar.
Tara: uploaded hero variants here: https://drive.fake/hero-variants. rec: single CTA = "Estimate your bill" that opens a calc modal. Variant B uses short explainer copy under hero.
Jordan: analytics notes — please add utm_campaign=pricing_launch and track event: `pricing_calc_open`. capture custom prop `intent_score` from calc results. I'll set funnel goals: calc_open -> webinar_signup -> trial_start.
Liam: inbound routing proposal: high-intent (webinar signups + calc intent_score >= 0.7) -> AE queue; medium -> SDR nurture; low -> marketing drip. Need final mapping of calc fields to HubSpot properties.
Elaine: two fast decisions we need here: 1) calculator gating — email capture only for the 'Commitment estimator' variant? 2) final tier names. Sam suggested 'Committed' vs 'Dedicated' — any final thoughts?
Sam: also throw 'Reserved' into the mix. 'Reserved' might avoid enterprise-y connotations of 'Dedicated'.
Miguel: my vote: keep it simple. Starter / Committed / Enterprise. Avoid too many novel words — want clarity for buying teams.
Tara: :+1: on clear three-tier copy. also recommend a micro-FAQ accordion under the calculator explaining rounding, discounts, and commitment terms.
Jordan: target metric: webinar -> trial conversion 10% (stretch). For the calculator: we should aim for 15% calc_open -> webinar signup conversion.
Liam: I'll draft HubSpot routing rules. need the calc output columns (cost_estimate, commitment_length, intent_score). @Elaine can you paste the schema?
Elaine: draft calc schema snippet: `cost_estimate_usd`, `monthly_tokens`, `avg_seq_len`, `model_variant`, `commitment_months`. we'll add `intent_score` client-side. Anyone object to email-only gating for the commitment estimator?
Sam: fine with email gating for the premium estimator, but public quick-estimate should stay ungated.
Miguel: I'll own the benchmark write-up + the short methodology blurb (instance types, seq lengths, dataset samples). Will coordinate with Tara for visuals.
Tara: I'll finalize the assets by Wed EOD and put two hero + calc modal variants in the asset folder.
Elaine: publish schedule proposal: blog (benchmark) Wed 09:00 PT, pricing-page micro-updates Wed 18:00 PT (after QA), webinar Thurs 10:00 PT. objections?
Jordan: tight but ok. will have tracking ready and a quick dashboard for the first 24h.
Liam: works for me. will block time to build the HubSpot workflows Thu morning.
DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: pricing-page update -> CI pipeline at 2024-06-05T19:00:00Z. Monitor release channel for alerts.
Elaine: perfect — thanks all. I'll update the doc with owner tasks and due dates, and make a short launch checklist. :thumbsup:
